summary: A person asked to help by someone already active in the group often says yes, and about as many people start on their own as are asked.
realLife: Federal figures show about 41 percent of volunteers were asked and about 42 percent approached the group themselves; among those asked, most were asked by someone already involved.
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Volunteering in the United States news release: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/volun.nr0.htm
Lifeway Research, summary of volunteering patterns: https://research.lifeway.com/?p=6435
inGame: tie between asker and asked; the cause is carried by the asker's invitation.
